citations.A1: Module-level `_cache` never invalidated once set — fix: check file mtime/hash each call and reload when it changes.
citations.A2: reducing a TTL or "reload every N calls" (masks the bug, still serves stale data for up to N calls/seconds)
citations.A3: adding a manual `clear_cache()` function (doesn't fix the "stale-until-someone-remembers-to-call-it" problem, silent by default)
citations.A4: `path` param is ignored after first call (cache keyed by nothing) — fix: key the cache dict by `path`.
citations.A5: Not thread-safe (two threads can both see `_cache is None` and double-load, or one reads mid-write) — fix: guard with a lock.
citations.A8: `_cache is None` sentinel means an empty/falsy config (`{}`, `null`) reloads every call — fix: use a separate `bool` flag ("loaded") instead of `is None`.
